metadata.title: World of Warcraft: Midnight — PvE defensive cooldown reference
metadata.scope: Personal mitigation and immunities; external/group protection; major emergency recovery; passive cheat-death/internal timers; selected rotational mitigation and defensively modified throughput abilities.
exclusions: Racials, gear, set bonuses, trinkets and consumables except Warlock Healthstones
Routine healing rotations, general crowd control and mobility without a relevant defensive attachment
A complete catalogue of passive mitigation and healer throughput cooldowns
metadata.method: Compared current specialization guides with live spell tooltip records and dated Blizzard changes. Spec overrides take precedence over generic spell records when established. Source conflicts and incomplete mechanics remain explicit; this is a researched snapshot, not an in-client exhaustive validation.
metadata.completeness: All 40 specializations are covered. Absolute completeness of every talent interaction and exact values for flagged records could not be established from public sources.

conventions.base_seconds: Spec-adjusted cooldown before optional talents, haste and dynamic reductions; exceptions are explicit in notes.
conventions.variants: Illustrative sourced or calculated talent configurations, not every possible build. Conditional/disputed variants are labeled.
conventions.charges: Base charges. Recharge is per charge; two charges do not halve recharge time.
conventions.haste_scaled: When true, nominal recharge typically divides by (1 + haste_fraction); actual availability also depends on listed effects.
conventions.null: Unresolved or not applicable; never means zero.
conventions.effect_duration_seconds: Effect window, separate from cooldown; zero denotes instant, null denotes unresolved/variable/persistent.
conventions.dynamic_cooldown: Resource spending, events, resets or recovery-rate changes prevent a single universal effective cooldown.
conventions.access: Baseline means not gated by an optional talent in the checked spec. Class/spec/hero talent labels require that selection or an automatically granted starting node. Named replacement/attachment requirements are detailed in modifiers.
conventions.verification: sourced means supported by the cited public material, not directly tested in-game. Other status values flag limits.

class_notes.Death Knight: Shared tools apply to Blood, Frost and Unholy. San’layn is Blood/Unholy; Deathbringer is Blood/Frost. Routine Bone Shield generation and passive damage reduction are outside the timed cooldown list.
class_notes.Demon Hunter: Netherwalk is not listed as a current PvE defensive in the checked Midnight Havoc tree. Blur no longer warrants copying an older expansion’s dodge description. Vengeance Brand is described as personal mitigation in current sources.
class_notes.Druid: Renewal is not included as a current active button: Midnight replaced it with Aessina’s Renewal. Bear Form itself is a stance, not a timed cooldown. Some current-labeled glossaries still contain pre-Midnight Heart of the Wild/Renewal text.
class_notes.Evoker: Emerald Communion is not included as a current PvE cooldown. Renewing Blaze is folded into Obsidian Scales. Routine Living Flame, Verdant Embrace and other healing rotation abilities are not all duplicated here.
class_notes.Hunter: All three specs share the listed core buttons. Pack Leader and Dark Ranger modifiers apply only to the listed specs. Fortitude of the Bear is now passive 3% damage reduction from a Tenacity pet for Beast Mastery/Survival, not the historical 120 s active health cooldown.
class_notes.Mage: Mass Barrier and Shifting Power are not current buttons in this reference. Barrier, Ice Block and Alter Time modifiers should not be inferred from a previous expansion. Mirror Image and Greater Invisibility are listed as utility because their old baseline damage reductions are absent.
class_notes.Monk: Diffuse Magic is a Fortifying Brew modifier, not a separate 90 s button. Dampen Harm and Zen Meditation are not carried over as current PvE cooldowns. Passive Yu’lon’s Grace is ongoing magic absorption rather than a selectable cooldown window.
class_notes.Paladin: Forbearance is a target lockout, distinct from cooldown. Protection does not get Divine Protection as another independent defensive alongside its replacement Ardent Defender. Eye of Tyr is not carried over. Lightsmith is Holy/Protection; Templar is Protection/Retribution.
class_notes.Priest: Routine healer throughput cooldowns are not exhaustively listed. Holy cannot be assigned Discipline’s Barrier/Pain Suppression. Angelic Bulwark and Protective Light are included separately from genuine death prevention.
class_notes.Rogue: All three specs have the shared core list. Float Like a Butterfly is Outlaw-only. Evasion and Feint remain available with Cheat Death, but lose the extra Elusiveness damage reduction.
class_notes.Shaman: Stone Bulwark Totem, Totemic Recall and Ancestral Protection Totem are not imported from older expansion lists. Enhancement’s Maelstrom Weapon healing and Restoration’s routine healing rotation are resource/throughput tools, not additional personal mitigation cooldowns.
class_notes.Warlock: Soul Leech, Demon Skin, Fel Armor and Soul Link are ongoing defenses, not independent timed buttons. Routine Drain Life and pet-healing tools are outside the major-cooldown list. Normal Healthstones are a shared consumable available to every spec if supplied.
class_notes.Warrior: Protection’s Last Stand is attached to Shield Wall. Arms/Fury should not be assigned tank Shield Wall or routine Shield Block availability just because a generic spell record exists. Stance lockouts and Rage-funded mitigation are shown separately.
